task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OIDC-01 at src/design/oidc-01-pluggable-provider-interface.md. Define a provider-agnostic IdentityProvider contract that cleanly isolates Keycloak specifics in adapter packages. Specify module boundaries, interface methods (token verification, user lookup, realm/tenant provisioning, user provisioning, role grant management, client provisioning, IDP federation management, audit event retrieval), error taxonomy, data contracts, dependency inversion points, and migration-safe coexistence with existing IDN token path. Include explicit traceability from OIDC-01 acceptance criteria to design sections and identify backend touchpoints for implementation and tests. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines a concrete IdentityProvider contract and module/package boundaries
Design ensures no Keycloak-specific coupling outside adapter package
Design maps OIDC-01 acceptance criteria to implementable test points
Design identifies auth subsystem call paths that must depend only on interface
Design includes implementation touchpoints and rollback-safe rollout notes

result.summary: Design artefact for OIDC-01 completed: provider-agnostic IdentityProvider contract, module boundaries isolating Keycloak specifics, error taxonomy, data contracts, dependency inversion points, migration-safe coexistence with existing IDN token path, acceptance traceability, and implementation/test touchpoints.
